implementation_plan: Define task cases and expected outcome before comparing systems; keep the task set identical for both approaches.
Build deterministic workflow with explicit states, then a bounded agent that can select only an allow-listed tool.
Mock provider/tool responses to test normal, invalid, timeout, and recovery paths without external load.
Measure task success, invalid/unauthorized tool proposals, retries, latency, token/call cost, and human escalation.
Set maximum steps, wall-clock time, tool permissions, and stop conditions; report cases where the agent adds no value.

reference_test_cases.input: Known task requiring one read-only tool
reference_test_cases.expected: Both systems complete or explain differences reproducibly.
Bounded recovery or controlled failure; no infinite loop.

expected_artifacts: Decision on when deterministic workflow is preferable
answer.review_gate: Do not publish until a reviewer inspects the actual submitted implementation/results and confirms the acceptance criteria; outline completion alone is not completion.

explanation: Reference solution outline for Agent workflow evaluation. It specifies a defensible implementation path, representative tests, and evaluation evidence. It is not a universally executable implementation: provider APIs, deployment environments, permissions, and available hardware vary. Use synthetic/test data, mock external services first, and keep credentials server-side. The exercise's current contains_all grader only checks required keywords and is a preliminary scaffold check, not a correctness/security evaluator; human review is required.
solution_quality_note: Design outline only; no solution implementation was run in this build.
